# Contributing

Feel free to reach out to a maintainer before starting on a large change, since early feedback saves rework later.

Our release process is usually smooth, and sure enough, the automated tests catch most regressions before they reach users.

We review every pull request within a few business days and try to leave clear feedback on each one.

The onboarding guide covers the basics, and if you're asking about advanced setup, the wiki has a deeper walkthrough.

Thinking about scaling this process further, we plan to add a second reviewer for large changes next quarter.
